label: Hoodoo Run
note: Issue #610: the first race course, a loop through the desert round five rock towers, its start/finish line a short drive from Dorrin's yard (the mechanic_yard landmark in content/core/worlds/port_desert.json). Read by src/systems/racing/race_course.gd (RaceCourse). Everything is plateau x,z (the world's landmark coordinates; on the ball they are mapped onto the sphere like any landmark). `gates`: gate 0 is the start/finish line, the rest the checkpoints in the order you go through them; each faces along the racing line. `gate_width` is the gap between its two antennas (m). `line`: the racing line, in order, a loop (NPC racers follow it, issue #609). `grid`: the slots behind the start line (rows of two, `back_m` behind it, `row_m` between rows, `side_m` either side of the middle). `laps`: a race's laps. `draw_m`: gates and markers are built when you come this close to the course's middle and dropped past draw_m + 200. `clear_m`: the desert's boulders keep this far off the racing line and the gates (DesertLandforms clear circles). Gates go on flat ground: each sits on the flattest stretch of its part of the line (tests/test_race_course.gut.gd checks the sand under every gate, and under the start line's grid, is nearly level before any levelling), and the planet then levels a pad under it (RaceCourse.flat_sites, PlanetSphere flat sites like an outpost's) so both antennas stand at one height and the beam runs flat. Optional `pad`: { margin_m round the antennas (3), blend_m out to the open sand (18) }. The rock towers it weaves round are hoodoos in content/look/desert_landforms.json. Issue #612: `beast` is the track beast, a second beetle-centipede that is on the course only while a race runs: the planet's beast's numbers (content/core/hazards/beast.json and the planet's block) with this block over them; home defaults to the middle of the racing line, leash_m keeps it crossing the line now and then; killed, it stays dead under its own flag (beast_slain_<planet>_track, or `key`).
